name: NessGate
description: The open, neutral compatibility resolver for the agentic web. Given a domain, NessGate reads the machine-readable resources that domain publishes at the standard discovery locations (llms.txt, ARD / ai-catalog.json, A2A agent card, RFC 9727 api-catalog, ai-info.json, OpenAPI, Open Resource Discovery, host-meta) and returns one normalized answer, each record linking back to its source on the domain. NessGate reads on demand, stores nothing, and makes no ownership or safety claim.
principles: reads the standards a domain already publishes; defines no new format
the domain is the source of truth; NessGate stores nothing and rehosts nothing
no accounts, no registration, no ranking; free to use
reports what a domain serves and links back to each source; makes no ownership or safety claim
open specification; Apache-2.0 reference implementation; anyone may run their own resolver
